node.title: Re: Memory leak in unicode substitution
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I can confirm the leak here too (Linux), with something as simple as the following, on Perl versions 5.18 and up, earlier versions don't leak. Definitely report this via [doc://perlbug].

#!/usr/bin/env perl use warnings; use strict; for ( 0..500 ) { for ( 0..1000 ) { (my $x = "x") =~ s/\x{2122}/(TM)/sg; } system("ps -hovsz $$"); }
